<thought>Retrieve polymorph data for a comprehensive list of nitride compositions (up to 39) using the provided batch tool, respecting the energy and per‑composition limits, and store the JSON files in a dedicated directory within the workdir.</thought>
<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>
<action_input>{
    "compositions": [
        "Li3N","AlN","Si3N4","BN","TiN","VN","ZrN","HfN","NbN","TaN",
        "MoN","WN","CrN","FeN","CoN","NiN","Mg3N2","Ca3N2","Sr3N2","Ba3N2",
        "GaN","InN","Cd3N2","Pb3N2","Sn3N4","Ge3N4","SiN","ScN","Y3N5","LaN",
        "CeN","PrN","NdN","SmN","GdN","TbN","DyN","ErN","YbN"
    ],
    "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
    "max_per_composition": 3,
    "save_directory": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/workdir/5/ml_nitrides_trial_6/polymorph_data"
}</action_input>
